name: Video Review Script — list generated videos with metadata for manual posting
goal: Build scripts/scs001/review-videos.ts — lists videos from the latest pipeline run with hook_formula, speaker, topic, QC status, and file path. Enables operator to review and select which video to post manually. Completes the manual posting loop: pipeline → review → record-manual-post.ts.
rationale: Pipeline generates videos but operator has no easy way to see what was produced. This script bridges the gap between pipeline output and manual TikTok posting decision.
swarm: NOT USED — new small script, writing directly.

tasks.title: scripts/scs001/review-videos.ts — video review CLI
tasks.description: Read latest run dir (newest workspace/scs001/run-*/ by mtime). Read experiments.jsonl to get hook_formula+speaker+qc_passed per video_id. List captioned MP4s with their metadata, sorted by qc_passed=true first. Show: video_id, hook_formula, speaker, qc_passed, file_path. Include --run-id flag to specify a specific run.
